backfillQueue.scanProgressFinishesRest: The scan in progress finishes; the rest is dropped

cloneSheet.youCanHideClone: You can hide this. The clone carries on, and the workspace is scanned when it lands.
cloneSheet.archstatsClonesYourOwn: Archstats clones it with your own git credentials, then scans it.
cloneSheet.httpsSshAddressOwner: An https or SSH address, or owner/repo for GitHub.
cloneSheet.name: Name
cloneSheet.keptArchstatsBroughtUp: Kept by Archstats: brought up to date before each scan, and deleted with the workspace.
cloneSheet.yourFolderArchstatsNever: Your folder: Archstats never updates it or deletes it.
cloneSheet.folderAlreadyExistsNot: That folder already exists and is not empty. Change the location.
cloneSheet.nothingLeavesMachineExcept: Nothing leaves this machine except git's own fetch.
cloneSheet.everyCommitChurnCo: Every commit: churn, co-change, authors and every history view work. The largest download.
cloneSheet.oneCommitNoHistory: One commit and no history: the structure views work, the git views stay empty. The fastest.
cloneSheet.serverPackingRepository: The server is packing the repository
cloneSheet.commitsPastTwelveMonths: Commits from the past twelve months. History views cover that year only.

importSnapshotSheet.noCodeViewerWill: no: the code viewer will be empty
importSnapshotSheet.fewFilesWorkspaceS: Few of its files are in that workspace's folder; it may be another codebase.

outdatedSnapshotBar.headHasMovedCommit: HEAD has moved to a commit this scan's history does not reach (a rebase, a force-push or an unfetched history).
outdatedSnapshotBar.scanWasWrittenAnalysis: This scan was written by analysis revision {_snapshotRevision}; this build runs revision {_engineRevision}.
outdatedSnapshotBar.checkoutSHeadDiffers: The checkout's HEAD differs from the commit this scan read.

rescanCommitSheet.scanDidNotRecord: This scan did not record its commit. HEAD at scan time was probably:
rescanCommitSheet.subject: Subject
rescanCommitSheet.scansCleanCheckoutCommit: Scans a clean checkout of that commit in a temporary clone; your working copy is not touched.
rescanCommitSheet.originalScanSUncommitted: The original scan's {dirty} uncommitted {are} not included.
rescanCommitSheet.newSnapshotReadBuild: The new snapshot is read by this build's analysis, revision {value}.

scanPanel.rebuiltCleanClone: Rebuilt from {value} in a clean clone
scanPanel.scanRepositorySTags: Scan the repository's tags, each in a clean clone, to fill in history
scanPanel.scanCommitAgainBuild: Scan commit {slice} again with this build's analysis
scanPanel.scanCommitHeadWas: Scan the commit HEAD was at when this scan ran
scanPanel.sameSnapshotWithoutStored: The same snapshot without the stored text of every file
scanPanel.copyHoldsStoredText: The copy holds the stored text of every file, import lines, commit subjects and author emails.
scanPanel.folderGoneMoveBack: The folder is gone. Move it back, or delete this workspace.
scanPanel.notGitCheckoutScan: Not a git checkout: a scan reads the folder as it is, with no history.
scanPanel.scanFetchesLatestFirst: Scan fetches the latest from {value} first.
scanPanel.snapshotsHereDidNot: The snapshots here did not record their commit; the next scan will.
scanPanel.headCommitNewestSnapshot: HEAD is on a commit the newest snapshot's history does not reach.
scanPanel.nothingNewSinceNewest: Nothing new since the newest snapshot.
scanPanel.nothingNewSinceNewest2: Nothing new since the newest snapshot; scan anyway

scanTagsSheet.eachTagScannedOwn: Each tag is scanned in its own temporary clone with this build's analysis, one after another; your working copy is not touched. The scans can't be interrupted, so stopping lets the current one finish.
scanTagsSheet.repositoryHasNoTags: This repository has no tags. A single commit can be rescanned from a snapshot's menu.
scanTagsSheet.snapshotCommitExistsAlready: A snapshot of this commit exists already

storageSheet.selectSnapshotsDeleteOpen: Select snapshots to delete. The open one and each baseline stay.
storageSheet.snapshotsOver1Gb: Snapshots over 1 GB from an older analysis are smaller when scanned again.

workspaceEmptyState.archstatsReadsSourceMachine: Archstats reads the source on this machine and keeps every snapshot, so you can come back later and see what changed.
workspaceEmptyState.checkoutParentFolderHolding: A checkout, or a parent folder holding several.
workspaceEmptyState.dropOneWindow: or drop one on this window
workspaceEmptyState.clonedYourOwnGit: Cloned with your own git credentials, then scanned.
workspaceEmptyState.everythingRunsLocallyNothing: Everything runs locally. Nothing is uploaded.
workspaceEmptyState.largeRepositoriesTakeFew: Large repositories take a few minutes. You can switch workspaces meanwhile.
workspaceEmptyState.fixCauseFirstIf: Fix the cause first if the message names one.
workspaceEmptyState.runScanBuildFirst: Run a scan to build the first snapshot. Every later scan is kept alongside it.

workspaceSettingsSheet.pathsGitignoreSyntaxOne: Paths in .gitignore syntax, one per line, on top of the repository's own ignore files: generated clients, fixtures, a vendored folder nobody ignored. Their files are not read and their history is dropped. CODEOWNERS is never left out.
workspaceSettingsSheet.filesWouldLeftOut: {value} of {value2} files would be left out
workspaceSettingsSheet.changingTheseMakesNext: Changing these makes the next scan not comparable with earlier ones: they read different code. Changes will say so.

workspaceSwitcher.folderWasAlreadyWorkspace: That folder was already a workspace, so it opened.
workspaceSwitcher.archstatsMadeCloneGoes: Archstats made this clone; it goes with the workspace.
workspaceSwitcher.folderDiskUntouched: The folder on disk is untouched.

workspaceConfig.fileHoldsNoWorkspace: The file holds no workspace config.
workspaceConfig.notArchstatsWorkspaceConfig: This is not an Archstats workspace config or groups export.
workspaceConfig.fileWasWrittenNewer: The file was written by a newer Archstats (config version {version}).
